concepts.label: Blood components
quotes: Blood is made of four main components.
Plasma is the pale yellow liquid part
Platelets are small cell fragments that help blood clot.

concepts.label: Haemoglobin is inside red blood cells
quotes: Haemoglobin is not a separate component of blood:
it is the protein inside red blood cells that carries oxygen.

concepts.label: Haemostasis sequence
quotes: the body stops the bleeding in a fixed order called haemostasis.
First, the damaged vessel narrows, which is called vascular spasm,
Next, platelets stick to the damaged wall and to each other,
Then clotting factors in the plasma work together to turn fibrinogen into fibrin,
Finally, the clot tightens and the vessel wall is repaired,

concepts.label: Fibrin mesh traps blood cells
quotes: fibrin, which forms a mesh of threads that traps blood cells.

concepts.label: Platelet lifespan
quotes: Platelets live for only about 7 to 10 days,
so the body makes new ones all the time.

concepts.label: Normal platelet count
quotes: A normal platelet count is between 150,000 and 450,000 platelets per microlitre of blood.

concepts.label: Vitamin K and clotting factors
quotes: The liver needs vitamin K to make several clotting factors.

concepts.label: Haemophilia
quotes: Haemophilia is an inherited disorder in which the blood does not clot normally
because a clotting factor is missing or does not work properly.
